_comment: 72-hour run, armed 2026-07-31T01:30Z on Jon's instruction: 'run
continuously for 72 hours -- there is so much to do we won't get it all done
within that time, so there is no reason to even set a stopping criteria.'
THE RELEASE IS THE DEADLINE, NOT THE CHECKS. Every check below names a test,
a build, or a deleted code path, and the ledger check is deliberately
unsatisfiable in spirit: if every row in the ledger is closed, the correct
response is to go read docs/planning, find the next item, WRITE IT DOWN, and
keep working -- not to stop.
This file is COMMITTED on purpose. .goal/active.json is a copy of it, and
editing either one to end the run early leaves a diff in a tracked file with
this comment sitting next to it. That is the whole security model, stated
honestly: the guard converts 'convince a judge' into 'falsify a specific
artifact', and nothing more. Only Jon ends this run.
max_run_hours is 74 rather than the 36h default because the default fuse
would release the run at the halfway mark. max_stalled_blocks is 40 because
the stall counter counts BLOCKS WITH NO NEW COMMIT, and a large architecture
slice legitimately spans many turns before it is committable -- but not 40.
A check that TIMES OUT counts as failing, which keeps the run open. That is
the safe direction and it is why the per-check timeouts here are moderate
rather than generous.
goal: Work continuously for 72 hours on docs/planning, prioritising ARCHITECTURE items that make future work easier -- a seam, an authority, a lifecycle boundary, or a measurement that can move -- over items that only make one game better. The spine is docs/planning/queue-72h-2026-07-31.md: S1 slice H (the facade's edges become optional capabilities), S2 match activation as a transaction, S3 the AC24 fixture that rewinds across an activation, S4 the body-generic damage authority then stocks, S5 session-owned combat tuning, S6 check_agent_kb green, S7 the FB4b decision rig. Backlog rows are carried in queue-24h-2026-07-26.md and remain in scope. THERE IS NO COMPLETION CRITERION: if the ledger looks empty, the next item has not been WRITTEN DOWN yet -- go read docs/planning, add it, and get back to work. Do not write a completion-shaped summary while time remains; that prose is the exact artifact that ends runs early.

checks.name: the ledger has no open rows (refill it rather than stopping)
the app compiles (the gate, not a per-crate check)
S1 slice H: the facade's capabilities are optional and it builds without them
S1 slice H: the absence contracts and the footprint ratchet are green
S2 match activation constructs every seat in ONE transaction
checks.cmd: out=$( { $HOME/.cargo/bin/cargo test -p ambition_platformer2d_actor_monolith --lib activation_transaction 2>&1; $HOME/.cargo/bin/cargo test -p ambition_app --features rl_sim --test app_it activation_transaction 2>&1; } || true ); echo "$out" | grep -E 'test result: ok\. [1-9][0-9]* passed' >/dev/null
